---
title: "Interface"
---

This section of the documentation focuses on how the interface is
implemented. It is split into the following documents:

-   The [Inputs](inputs.qmd) accepted by Flower.
-   The [Outputs](outputs.qmd), including the different styles for
    generating documentation from the `datapackage.json` file.
-   The [Command Line Interface](cli.qmd) that forms the main entry
    point.
-   The [Configuration settings](config.qmd) as a Python class and
    within a file.
-   The [Python interface](python.qmd) that contains the Python code
    that powers the CLI Python functions.
